paragraphs: R' Chanina bar Izka. See the entry R' Chanina bar Yaka.[^1]

notes.text: The heading has בר עיזקא, bar Izka; the target has בר יקה, bar Yaka. The target’s final he spelling יקה is retained rather than harmonized with יקא elsewhere. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
